cases.case_label: SVA in AP3B1 intron 7 causing premature polyadenylation (HPS2)
cases.mechanism_detail: A maternally inherited ~2.63-kb SVA in AP3B1 intron 7, in trans with a paternal exon 8-11 deletion, activates a cryptic polyadenylation site so that transcripts terminate shortly after exon 7 (3' RACE long-read cDNA and RNA-seq), reading 25 codons into intron 7 before a stop.
cases.quote: In our patient, SVA insertion activates a cryptic polyadenylation site causing premature termination of transcription, which has been described in L1 but not SVA retrotransposons.
